PAT-auth.description: Personal access token for non-browser clients. Mint at Settings → API Tokens. Carries one of two scopes: `read` (list/get Routes, export GPX, profile) or `write` (`read` plus metadata-only mutations on owned routes and on preferences). Blocked from /admin/* and from DELETE /users/me. Destructive operations require `X-Routess-Confirm: true` and return 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED otherwise. See ADR-0022 and ADR-0023.

idHash.description: Pseudonymous user identifier for client-side ProductEvent tracking. See ADR-0020.

deletionStatus.description: Deletion lifecycle. 'pending_hard_delete' means the user has requested self-deletion and is in the 30-day grace window before permanent erasure. The web app should redirect such users to a cancel screen.

deletionRequestedAt.description: When self-deletion was requested. Hard-delete fires 30 days after this timestamp.

hasPassword.description: Whether the user has an active email/password credential. Drives password-change UI affordances.

currentPassword.description: Required if changing an existing password.

code.description: Google OAuth2 authorization code from the popup auth-code flow

idHash.description: Pseudonymous user identifier for client-side ProductEvent tracking. See ADR-0020.

deletionStatus.description: Deletion lifecycle. 'pending_hard_delete' means the user has requested self-deletion and is in the 30-day grace window before permanent erasure. The web app should redirect such users to a cancel screen.

deletionRequestedAt.description: When self-deletion was requested. Hard-delete fires 30 days after this timestamp.

hasPassword.description: Whether the user has an active email/password credential. Drives password-change UI affordances.

isCurrent.description: True for the session that issued the JWT on this request. Cannot be revoked from the list.

label.description: Human-readable label so the user can identify the token later in the Settings list. Not displayed to anyone but the owning user.

scope.description: Scope of the token. `read` covers list/get/export and reading the profile. `write` adds metadata-only mutations on owned routes and on user preferences.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry. When omitted the token does not expire and lives until the user revokes it.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent time the token was used to authenticate a request, or null if never used since creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the token has no expiry.

token.description: The plaintext bearer token. Returned exactly once at creation time; the API does not store it and there is no way to retrieve it later. If you lose it, revoke the token and mint a new one.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the token.

lastUsedAt.description: Most recent time the token was used to authenticate a request, or null if never used since creation.

expiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp, or null if the token has no expiry.
